scope: Pooled retrospective terminal results from seven candidates in the r14, r15 and independent GPT matched dev screens, including the frozen GPT control alternative.
limitations: Terminal outcomes identify the deciding rule, without establishing the causal mechanism.
Repeated maps and shared comparators make the pooled counts descriptive, with no independent-game confidence interval.
The candidates were drawn from previous screens and are not representative of all development strategies.

nextAuthorRound.primaryQuestion: Does a paired mechanism ablation show that more productive tower building or tower contests convert into better match score?
